name: Waybar Pill Bar
author: Estivenm06
description: Rust pill bar and notch service. Enabling provisions managed files and replaces the native bar, notifications and OSD; disabling or removal restores files and the native desktop. Preferences and credentials remain.

requirements.note: Enabling the plugin installs missing packages with pacman through pkexec (or sudo in a terminal). Set PILL_BAR_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 to only list them.
